title: Where South Florida Is Going Out This Friday
igCaption:
Friday has boats in Key West, dinner in Little River, and concerts after dark.
Nov 6, South Florida, price varies

Sources: WSVN 7News, Miami New Times, stupidDOPE, Secret Miami

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #MiamiWeekend #ThingsToDoMiami

scenes.text: Where do you go this Friday when South Florida has powerboat racing, a new dinner spot, and arena concerts?
Start in Key West. The 45th Annual Offshore Powerboat World Championship kicked off Wednesday, with more racing scheduled for Friday and Sunday.
scenes.caption: Start in Key West. The 45th Annual Offshore Powerboat World Championship kicked off Wednesday, with more racing scheduled for Friday and Sunday.

scenes.text: For dinner, Anako opened October 22 at 8222 NE Second Ave. in Little River. Chefs Leicel Ros and Nancy Dominguez built it after Sili at 1-800-Lucky, with dishes like lumpia, kinilaw crudo, and oxtail kare-kare.
